ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) distribution across the visible fluke plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white contiguous blobs dominate the medial regions of both lobes; low-intensity pixels form a continuous peripheral border along the trailing edge and manifest as high-density linear filaments crisscrossing the medial white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression; calculated internal angle of approximately 35 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) concentrated along the trailing edge; more pronounced jagged peaks localized towards the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory on both lobes, terminating in sharp distal tips oriented dorsolaterally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters (~10-20 pixels in diameter) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; isolated dark circular rings observed on the mid-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive, multi-directional dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 50 to 300 pixels in length, creating a cross-hatch pattern over the white ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across both lobes and significant cluster-based calcified protrusions (barnacles) on the lobe terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cross-hatched scarring pattern covers >60% of the visible white surface area, creating a unique high-frequency textural signature.
